# Propane Nozzle: ELAFLEX GasGuard GG40 K15 propane nozzle and hose kits

> Independent US reseller of the ELAFLEX GasGuard GG40 quick-connect (K15) propane nozzle and matching autogas hose kits. Also hosts the complete GG20 1¾" ACME nozzle reference (no longer sold). Sourced from ELAFLEX documentation.

## Products
- [GG40 nozzle and hose kits: product page and quote](https://propanenozzle.com/)
- [GG20 reference page](https://propanenozzle.com/gg20/)
- [Full knowledge base, plain text](https://propanenozzle.com/knowledge/gasguard-kb.md)

## GG40 and hose-kit guides
- [ELAFLEX GasGuard GG40: the K15 Quick-Connect Propane Nozzle](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg40-k15-quick-connect-nozzle): What the GasGuard GG40 is, how K15 quick-connect propane filling works, who it is for, and the figures ELAFLEX publishes: up to 17 GPM, under 1 cm³ release, UL approved.
- [GG40 vs GG20: K15 Quick Connect vs 1¾" ACME, Which Nozzle Your Vehicles Need](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg40-vs-gg20-acme-vs-k15): K15 push-on (GG40) or 1¾" ACME thread (GG20)? The NFPA 58 rule for 2020-and-later vehicles, what each nozzle fits, and how the two compare on flow, release and lever effort.
- [GG40 Part Numbers and Options: Latched, Unlatched and Inlet](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg40-part-numbers-and-options): How GasGuard GG40 nozzles are coded: latched (L) and unlatched versions, strainer (S), inlet thread, and what to confirm in words on every quote.
- [Installing a GG40: Hose Kit, ARK 19.3 Pull-Away, Thread Sealing and Boot](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg40-installation-hose-and-boot): Fitting a GasGuard GG40 to a dispenser: the ELAFLEX LPG 16 S hose, ARK 19.3 pull-away, thread sealing without PTFE tape, leak testing, and the NB-GG boot.
- [Will a GG40 Work With My Dispenser? K15 Hose Kits on Parafour and Others](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg40-dispenser-compatibility): How to tell whether a GasGuard GG40 fits your propane dispenser: hose-end thread, pull-away, boot and reed switch, with notes on Parafour P4 dispensers.
- [GG40 Safety, Codes and Compliance: NFPA 58, K15 and UL](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg40-safety-codes-and-compliance): What NFPA 58 requires for K15 refueling, the GG40's UL approval, the latch question, PPE, emissions claims and who has the final say on an installation.
- [Autogas Hose Kits for the GG40: Hose, Pull-Away and Whip](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/autogas-hose-kits): What is in an autogas hose kit for the GasGuard GG40: ELAFLEX LPG 16 S hose, ARK 19.3 pull-away, whip, lengths and threads, and the UL and CSA listings behind them.
- [GG40 Maintenance, Repair and Warranty](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg40-maintenance-and-warranty): What ELAFLEX publishes about keeping a GasGuard GG40 in service: low maintenance, simple repair, the 18-month warranty, boot storage and when to call the manufacturer.

## GG20 reference guides
- [GG20 vs GG20H vs GG20DN: Which GasGuard Nozzle to Buy](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg20-vs-gg20h-vs-gg20dn): How the three GasGuard GG20 nozzles differ: single, hybrid and dual nose pieces, flow, lever force, release volume and who each one is for.
- [GasGuard GG20 Specifications: Complete Technical Data](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg20-specifications): Every published spec for the ELAFLEX GasGuard GG20: reach, flow, pressure, temperature, materials, seals, weight, strainer and standards, in metric and US units.
- [GG20 Part Numbers Decoded: Nose Pieces, Inlets and Option Codes](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg20-part-numbers-and-options): How to read a GasGuard GG20 part number: GG20/GG20H/GG20DN, .2 and .3 inlets, and the J, S, L, G and B option codes, plus how distributors label them.
- [Installing a GG20: Hose, Thread Sealing, Safety Break and Boot](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg20-installation-and-hose-assembly): Installation guidance for the GasGuard GG20 from the ELAFLEX manual: thread sealing (no PTFE tape), leak testing, recommended hose, ARK 19 safety break and NB-GG boot.
- [How to Fill Forklift Cylinders and RVs with a GasGuard GG20](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/how-to-fill-forklift-cylinders-and-rvs-with-gg20): Step-by-step GG20 operating procedure from the ELAFLEX manual, applied to forklift motor fuel cylinders and recessed RV fill valves, with PPE and stop conditions.
- [GG20 Inspection and Maintenance Schedule: Daily, 6 to 12 Months, 24 Months](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg20-inspection-and-maintenance): The ELAFLEX inspection schedule for GasGuard GG20 nozzles: daily visual checks, the 6 to 12 month inspection list, and the 24-month seal kit replacement.
- [GG20 Repair and Pressure Testing: What the Service Manual Covers](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg20-repair-and-testing): Overview of the GasGuard GG20 repair and maintenance manual: assemblies, tools, lubricants, rejection criteria, static and dynamic test procedures and test pressures.
- [GG20 Troubleshooting: Leaks, Hard Connections, No Flow, Stiff Lever](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg20-troubleshooting): Symptoms, likely causes and actions for common GasGuard GG20 problems, based on the ELAFLEX operating and repair manuals.
- [GG20 Safety, Codes and Compliance: UL 125, NFPA 58, Latches and Rule 1177](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg20-safety-codes-and-compliance): What the GasGuard GG20's UL 125 listing covers, why the latch option matters, how the GG20 compares to the Rule 1177 low-emission limit, and LPG hazards to train for.
- [Will a GG20 Work With My Dispenser? Compatibility Checklist](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg20-dispenser-compatibility): How to tell whether a GasGuard GG20 fits your propane dispenser, hose and fill valves, plus dispensers known to ship for it, including Parafour's P4-100, P4-150 and P4-200.
- [GG20 on the Parafour P4-075 Dispenser](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg20-parafour-p4-075): Using a GasGuard GG20 nozzle on the Parafour P4-075 single-hose autogas dispenser: what's published, what to check, and which GG20 to order.
- [GG20 on the Parafour P4-100 Single Hose Autogas Dispenser](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg20-parafour-p4-100): The Parafour P4-100 single-hose autogas dispenser is built for the GasGuard GG20. Which GG20 to order, inlet size, magnet option and what ships with the dispenser.
- [GG20 on the Parafour P4-150 Dual Product Dispenser](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg20-parafour-p4-150): The Parafour P4-150 runs a GasGuard GG20 on its autogas hose and a cylinder fill nozzle on the second hose. Which GG20 to order and what to check.
- [GG20 on the Parafour P4-200 Dual Hose Autogas Dispenser](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg20-parafour-p4-200): The Parafour P4-200 dual-hose autogas dispenser is built for the GasGuard GG20 on both hoses. Which GG20 to order for each lane, inlet size and magnet option.
- [GasGuard Family Compared: GG1, GG20, GG30, GG40 and ZVG 2](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gasguard-family-gg1-gg20-gg30-gg40): Which ELAFLEX LPG nozzle fits which fill point: GG1 and GG20 (1¾" ACME), GG30 (bayonet), GG40 (K15 quick connect) and ZVG 2 EURO UL, with key specs.
- [Replacing a GasGuard LG20 with a GG20](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/lg20-to-gg20-replacement): The GasGuard GG20 range supersedes the LG20. What to check before ordering the replacement: nose piece, inlet size, latch and magnet.
- [LPG Nozzle Glossary: Terms Used in GG20 Documentation](https://propanenozzle.com/guides/gg20-glossary): Plain definitions of the terms in GasGuard GG20 specs and manuals: ACME, nose piece, release volume, reach, swivel, reed switch, safety break, AHJ, UL 125, K15.
